title: Book Three · Chapter 106: The Whole Reason
story:
On Thursday, Ronan asks Anna to walk with him after school.

“Only to the crossing,” she says. “I need to meet Lin.”

“All right.”

They leave the gate together. For a little while, they talk about a new school book. Then Ronan looks at the path ahead.

“I want to explain the morning.”

Anna keeps walking.

“I read your note.”

“I promised the man half past eight. I thought five minutes would be enough.”

“You told me none of that.”

“I know.”

He takes a breath.

“He wanted me to show the books. I liked that. He remembered me. I felt important.”

Anna looks at him then.

“That morning was important to me too.”

“Yes.”

“I put both our names down. I wanted you to hear the guide and see the models.”

Ronan looks at her notebook. The studio drawing is inside, but she has not shown it to him.

“Leo said I could go,” he says. “At twenty to nine. I could reach the library at nine.”

“You stayed.”

“Then I stayed after the first bus left too. I wanted the next sale.”

They reach the quiet part of the road. Anna stops near a low wall.

“I didn't ask you to stop selling books,” she says. “I asked you to come that morning.”

“I said yes.”

“I believed you.”

Ronan nods slowly. There is no late customer between them now. There is only his own answer.

“I'm sorry,” he says. “I want to see you again. I don't want to keep asking you to forget it.”

Anna rests her notebook against the wall.

“I can't forget it quickly.”

“I know.”

She looks down the road. A group of students passes on the other side.

“We can have lunch tomorrow,” she says at last. “At school. Lin will be there too.”

Ronan looks up.

“Yes.”

“I still need to go now.”

He steps back so she can lift her bag. They walk the last part together. At the crossing, he lets her take her own road.

The next day, Ronan brings his lunch to the desk. He does not bring a present or another note.

Anna sits down beside him. Lin comes over with her box. They talk about the morning lesson and a very bad drawing on the board.

Ronan says one quiet thing about its legs. Anna laughs once, then takes another bite.

He keeps eating. There is still space between their boxes, and the rest of lunch passes without another apology.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

believe＝相信；important＝重要的；quickly＝很快地；explain＝解释清楚。

## 理解问题

1. 除了顾客迟到，Ronan承认了哪一层自己的真实原因？
2. Anna有没有说自己马上忘记了？她主动提出了怎样的一小步相处？

## 读句子

**I wanted the next sale.**

拆开看：I / wanted / the next sale.

我／想要／再做成下一笔交易。
